The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-top-8-brian-fred-ls-diplo/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds T8 Fred LS Diplo.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>f63faba1d452ba6c3875baa700719cacaf8f14a87057fa4a281cba11e2436e70</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.
